shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/mempal-memory/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | head -200 && printf '\\n--- invoice references ---\\n' && rg -n \"invoice|Invoice|billable|since|until\" src tests 2>/dev/null | head -240"

/bin/bash -lc "mempal search \"toggl-cli entry invoice invoice-monthly billable monthly calendar\" --json --top-k 5
printf '\\n--- invoice search ---\\n'
rg -n -i \"invoice\" . --glob '"'!target/**'"' --glob '"'!Cargo.lock'"' || true
printf '\\n--- command modules and argument sections ---\\n'
sed -n '1,430p' src/arguments.rs
sed -n '1,430p' src/main.rs
sed -n '1,180p' src/commands/mod.rs"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git log --oneline --all -12 && printf '\\n--- Cargo ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' Cargo.toml"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1380,1510p' src/api/client.rs
sed -n '334,390p' src/models.rs
sed -n '380,455p' src/commands/list.rs
sed -n '1,100p' src/commands/me.rs
rg -n \"pub fn .*duration|round|15|quarter|format.*second|seconds\" src/utilities.rs src/commands src/models.rs | head -120
rg -n \"has_json_flag|impl Command\" src/arguments.rs"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '220,275p' src/api/client.rs
sed -n '700,750p' src/arguments.rs
sed -n '1,80p' src/commands/common.rs
sed -n '1,80p' src/commands/report.rs
sed -n '1,120p' src/commands/search.rs"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-cli-monthly-invoice.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Monthly invoice aggregation uses the established billing rule

Monthly invoice summaries should aggregate only completed billable time entries, rounding each entry independently up to the 15-minute billing interval before grouping. Calendar-month grouping uses the entry start instant in UTC, which keeps bucket assignment independent of the machine's local timezone.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals
git diff --check
git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt --check && cargo test commands::invoice_monthly && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check -- src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/commands/mod.rs && git status --short && nl -ba src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs | sed -n '1,130p'"

/bin/bash -lc "mempal search \"toggl-cli invoice-monthly json months billable_seconds total_billable_seconds\" --json --top-k 5
sed -n '130,195p' src/arguments.rs
sed -n '730,755p' src/arguments.rs
sed -n '245,270p' src/main.rs
sed -n '1,115p' src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-cli-monthly-invoice-json.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Monthly invoice JSON has a stable machine-readable schema

The monthly invoice JSON output uses a top-level "'`months` array with `month` and integer `billable_seconds` fields, plus `total_billable_seconds`. Empty results retain the same schema with an empty array and a zero total so consumers do not need a special case.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals
git diff --check -- src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/commands/invoice_monthly.rs
git status --short
git diff --stat -- src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/commands/mod.rs
'
